admissions.trigger: A new current measurement request or documented disposition is actually opened in play.
admissions.closure: A signed current disposition, documented refusal, or isolation decision; no historical cause is supplied.

admissions.trigger: Bart chooses to resume the paper trail, ask a known participant, or abandon it.
admissions.closure: A direct authorized statement may establish the bounded carrier-network link; otherwise close as unresolved/abandoned without inventing supporting history.

admissions.trigger: A future Gangrel approaches for an independently motivated local boundary inquiry; any rumor of Bart's strength requires a new witnessed deed and traceable relay.
admissions.closure: A bounded contact ends by answer, refusal, departure, or interruption; no report is transmitted unless its sender chooses and can reach its recipient.

admissions.trigger: Kuthulun acts from variant-bounded knowledge and/or a report with a recorded source and transfer; exact trigger is selected by play and never backdated.
admissions.closure: Resolve as played; target direction is a forced near-death Embrace after C05 and before 1970-12-25, but no scene, date, outcome, or state is pre-recorded.

admissions.trigger: Only after a validly played and persisted transformation.
admissions.closure: A trilha de adaptação posterior fecha quando as três histórias de adaptação previstas neste contrato são concluídas e uma escolha de adaptação de Bartholomeu é registrada. Tramas transversais do mundo não são requisito de encerramento.

admissions.trigger: Player and Narrator elect the 2010 review after enough actual play and state reconciliation.
admissions.closure: Graduation is complete, alternate, or incomplete against explicit evidence; no thread or single roll is mandatory.

frozen_boundaries: C05 is closed, its box remains unknown, and C06 has not started.
Bart remains mortal through every existing M3.01 scene; no past event is rewritten.
No exact dates are assigned to open intervals; only authorized relative ordering is used.
The labor-law anecdote is not treated as verified law or a date anchor.
The open carrier variant is not expanded with routes, participants, timing, or additional hidden facts.

status_legend.ADMITTED_OPTIONAL: May be pursued and locally closed, abandoned, or left quiet without blocking guided-creation completion.
status_legend.ADMITTED_REQUIRED_ROUTE: A bounded encounter is part of the intended path; it remains subject to actual play and player action.
status_legend.ADMITTED_REQUIRED_ROUTE_CONDITIONAL: Prepared as a future story but cannot be entered before its causal preconditions and operational gates.
status_legend.ADMITTED_REQUIRED_GATE: A finite review endpoint, not a mandatory resolution of every world thread.

crosswalk_note: D04 admission identifiers remain local to D04; each contract_ref maps them to a D07 story_id and anchor. The mapping is explicit in both successors.
